interactions.name: all 9 layout/view/resize states leave exact tree and dirty status unchanged
exit fullscreen restores heading/root-create and existing return navigation

differences.reason: Native Mind Elixir automatic layout with an existing display-only deck container; reference is custom forest HTML. 12 real node names, hierarchy, bodies and two roots matched; no custom engine or coordinate persistence.
Existing resizable 300px business panel and native Crepe toolbar/save UI replace fixed demo rich-text controls. Real direct/aggregate counts 1/1 versus prototype demo 14/14; no fabricated counts.

v3.7 primary control order, 32px icons and contextual child/sibling retained; necessary structural/recycle/save and existing exchange controls share wrapping secondary group. Fullscreen header suppressed like frozen source.
Native direction/spacing, theme palette and line shape retained; nodes fit canvas after public scaleFit. No manual symmetric layout.
Linux formal Electron supports scoped geometry/interaction review only. R7/R8 retain strict full-app and Windows/IME/physical clipboard acceptance.
Native branch palette remains pink/red and leaf selection lacks the prototype green card treatment; next checkpoint must use public theme/config only, no custom layout engine.

visualAcceptanceReason: Native palette/selection treatment and detail editor spacing still differ materially from v3.7; R5.a remains IN_PROGRESS. No pixel/Windows acceptance claimed.
